integrity: Proof gives full equivalence and three-world strictness; checker is finite corroboration. Earlier algebraic distribution and flat semantics are attributed. No independent validation has been performed.
limitations: Necessary and sufficient characterization is proved for finite nonempty flat frames only; no claim for arbitrary infinite frames, and no guarantee that older unindexed literature lacks an equivalent formulation.
title: Principal-refinement characterization of finite sharp flat Heyting–Lewis frames
